people.name: Noah
people.line: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood

translations.web: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.
translations.bsb: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation; Noah walked with God.
translations.kjv: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
translations.asv: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, and perfect in his generations: Noah walked with God.
